newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour vows "proper regulation" of buses.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour vows "proper regulation" of buses.

text.p: Britain's main opposition Labour Party on Thursday proposed a balanced transport system, including proper regulation of buses and a strategic review of the roads programme.

"The key to efficient bus services is proper regulation at local level, with partnerships between local councils and bus operators an essential component," Labour's manifesto for the May 1 election said.
The party said it remained unpersuaded by the case for heavier, 44-tonne lorries mooted by the Conservatives.

"We will conduct an overall strategic review of the roads programme against the criteria of accessibility, safety, economy and environmental impact, using public-private partnerships to improve road maintenance and exploiting new technology to improve journey information," it said.
